units.source_text: “生了病，医生禁止打台球，真不好办啊。

en.t: After I fell ill, the doctor forbade me from playing billiards, which is really troublesome.

units.source_text: 幸好还可以下一点将棋。”

en.t: Fortunately, I can still play a little shogi.

units.source_text: 名人说罢笑了笑，然后站起身来。

en.t: After saying this, the Master smiled, then rose to his feet.
